pages.text: The $(thing)Macrophage$() is slow, but it engulfs whatever it catches. Caught, you are held inside it and digested: strike it to break free. It eats items and red cells too, and gives the items back when it dies.

The $(thing)T Cell$() leaves you alone unless you are infected, or strike it. It hunts the anomalies that infect as well. The $(thing)Polymerase$() climbs the Nucleus's double helices rung by rung, copying the strand, and harms no one. Macrophages and T Cells both go for the Tumour Hydra, and it bites them back: fight it beside them.

The $(thing)Tumour Hydra$(), called with a $(item)Metastatic Spore$() on open ground in the Tumour, starts with three heads. Strike a head or its neck: every 30 damage cuts that head off, and its stump, left in the same place, is open for five seconds. Seal it with fire, or strike it with a $(item)CAR-T Cell Culture$() or an $(item)Apoptosis Trigger$(), and the head is gone for good; leave it, and it grows back with another beside it. With no heads left, its body takes blows in full and it can be killed. Its bite carries $(thing)Metastasis$().

Landmarks with caches: $(thing)Germinal Centres$() in the Lymph Node, $(thing)Nuclear Pores$() in the Nucleus and $(thing)Ribosome Workshops$() in Tissue. In the Overworld, abandoned $(thing)BSL-4 Field Stations$() hold the branch's first samples: sterile packs and cultures.
